snippet.title: [PV]Soaring Machinariae
snippet.description:
11 Jun, 2021 release
Developer: Kensei
Platform: Windows/Mac
Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1616030/Soaring_Machinariae/
Movie editing by :GODJAPAN Co.Ltd.

Introduction:
A girls' adventure story, told through a traditional action RPG!
Control Iris the Machinariae to explore fields and dungeons, and fight against monsters with sword combos, items, and special moves!
